description: METROPOLIS - State Representative and House Republican Floor Leader Patrick Windhorst is running for re-election as 117th District State Representative!The petition gathering season began on Tuesday, September 5th. with Illinois' March 19, 2024, Primary Election now just six months away. All completed petitions must be notarized by a licensed Notary Public, signed, dated, and affirmed only by the individual who passes the petition. The deadline to return completed forms to Rep. Windhorst is Wed.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Citizens for Patrick Windhorst
title: Sign State Rep. Patrick Windhorst's Petition!
